item.title: Iranian-Americans Celebrate Death of Supreme Leader, Discuss Steps Toward Regime Change
item.description: The United States and Israel have launched a major military offensive against Iran, marking a dramatic escalation in Middle East tensions. President Donald Trump confirmed Saturday afternoon that Iran’s supreme leader, Ali Khamenei, has been killed in the targeted strikes by the U.S. and Israel.

item.title: US Central Command: No Reports of US Casualties, Minimal Damage to US Installations in Strikes Against Iran
item.description: WASHINGTON, D.C. - President Donald Trump said Iran’s Supreme Leader has been killed. This follows an intensive strike between US and Israeli forces early Saturday morning. Experts said the killing could have a huge political shift in Iran and the Middle East.
